reason: A visual skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web that replaces the interface presentation with an interactive 3D study room and related navigation interactions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可探索的 3D 书房主题皮肤，并支持第一人称移动和场景交互。
summaries.en: A 3D study-room theme skin for DeepSeek Harness Web with first-person movement and interactive scene navigation.

capabilities: Changes the DeepSeek Harness Web visual presentation
Adds an interactive 3D study-room environment with first-person movement
Adds in-scene interactions for opening the workspace and leaving the room
Provides an illustration fallback when WebGL is unavailable
